svg.text: Left row: count from USB downward
TOP VIEW • components facing you • USB at the top
Crossing wires connect only at a dot.
12 V goes to VM only, never to the Pico.
EN is active LOW. The LED pin sinks: low = lit.
Tilt pair as built: GP6 = DIR, GP7 = STEP.
PDN (UART): one private line per driver, TX and RX
joined. Sets motor current, reads load and faults.
On-board LED (GP25, no wiring): heartbeat, one flash a second.
Motor: A1/A2 are one coil, B1/B2 the other.
Grey driver pins (UART, CLK) stay unconnected.
Optional: 100 µF 25 V across VM/GND at each driver.
